segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ כֹּל שֶׁחַבְתִּי בִּשְׁמִירָתוֹ – הִכְשַׁרְתִּי אֶת נִזְקוֹ. הִכְשַׁרְתִּי בְּמִקְצָת נִזְקוֹ – חַבְתִּי בְּתַשְׁלוּמֵי נִזְקוֹ כְּהֶכְשֵׁר כׇּל נִזְקוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «anything» for «which I became responsible for safeguarding it» to prevent it from causing damage, if it in fact causes damage, it is considered as if «I» actively «facilitated that damage,» and accordingly I must pay for it. In any case in which «I facilitated part of the damage it» caused, «I am liable for payments» of restitution «for damage it» caused, «as» if I were the «one who facilitated the entire damage it» caused.

segments.he: נְכָסִים שֶׁאֵין בָּהֶן מְעִילָה, נְכָסִים שֶׁהֵן שֶׁל בְּנֵי בְּרִית, נְכָסִים הַמְיוּחָדִים.
segments.en: One is liable only with regard to damage caused to «property» for «which,» were he to use it for a non-sacred purpose, he «would not be» liable «for» the «misuse» of consecrated property; with regard to damage caused to «property that belongs to members of the covenant,» i.e., Jews; and with regard to «assigned property,» the meaning of which the Gemara will explain.

segments.he: וּבְכׇל מָקוֹם, חוּץ מֵרְשׁוּת הַמְיוּחֶדֶת לַמַּזִּיק,
segments.en: «And» one is liable for damage caused «in any place except for a domain designated» exclusively «for» the use of «the one responsible for the damage.»
«And» one is liable for damage caused in «a domain» designated for the joint use «of the injured» party «and the one liable for the damage.»

segments.he: כְּשֶׁהִזִּיק חָב הַמַּזִּיק לְשַׁלֵּם תַּשְׁלוּמֵי נֶזֶק בְּמֵיטַב הָאָרֶץ.
segments.en: «When» an animal or item one is responsible to safeguard «causes damage, the one liable for the damage» caused by insufficiently safeguarding it «is obligated to pay payments» of restitution «for damage with» his best-quality «land.»

moves.summary: responsibility to guard makes one liable
facilitating part makes one liable for all

moves.cueHe: ובכל מקום, חוץ מרשות המיוחדת למזיק

positions.claim: one who must guard something is liable for its damage, payable from best land, except in the damager's own domain
